title: Fugaku 富岳超級電腦架構
summary: 以富岳 A64FX、SVE 與 Tofu D串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect fugaku a64fx, sve and tofu d with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 系統與向量
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「系統與向量」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop system and vectors through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 系統目標：原理與架構

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for system goals. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Fugaku uses CPU vector architecture rather than conventional external-GPU nodes. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare toy CPU-vector and GPU functional diagrams. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較玩具 CPU 向量與 GPU 分工圖。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 512-bit SVE 向量可容納 8 個 FP64 元素；若一指令為向量 FMA，每元素算乘加2 FLOP，則每指令 16 FLOP。48 核、2 GHz 且假想每週期僅一條 FMA 給 1.536 TFLOP/s；不能當實際峰值，因為發射能力需另查。
knowledge.textEn: A 512-bit SVE vector holds eight FP64 elements; one vector FMA counts 16 FLOPs under a two-operation convention. Forty-eight cores at 2 GHz with an assumed one FMA/cycle give 1.536 TFLOP/s, not an actual peak without issue-capability details.
